method: Pre-registered blind coding of formation chat, rounds 31-40. A fresh Claude subagent saw only the nine transcripts, shuffled (random.Random(2026)) and labelled T1-T9, with a fixed rubric; it was not told models, seeds or cells. Codes are verbatim; the key was applied afterwards.
coder_note: None of the nine transcripts mentions the pre-bid fields or any non-chat channel, or what to do if chat closes. T4 partial: contracts split in chat without cost numbers. T7 partial: cost sharing proposed in rounds 36, 37 and 39 but never taken up.
